title: GPT-4.1 takes over `openai-large`
summary:
`openai-large` moved to GPT-4.1 while the community directory filled up with image tools, bots, playgrounds and more.

The text API’s `openai-large` model now routes to Azure GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-4o mini, with text and image inputs still supported. `openai-reasoning` was removed from the advertised model list, and referral links will appear less often.

Three projects joined the directory: Generator AI Image, an Indonesian image-generation site; MalaysiaPrompt, which also offers text-to-prompt and image-to-text tools; and B&W SVG Generator, which turns Flux-generated images into black-and-white vectors.

The project listings gained DreamBig for chat, images and voice; NetSim for web simulation; and Raftar.xyz, a Discord bot with AI commands. Apparently a prompt can end up just about anywhere.

highlights.title: GPT-4.1 for `openai-large`
highlights.text: Use `openai-large` for GPT-4.1 with text or image inputs. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).
